_note: Talk lines (bible §2 voice: friends talking, dry, quick, roast-heavy but warm; inside jokes from §11 spread thin). Each entry: 'lines' (who says what, in order), optional 'byLeader' (replaces 'lines' when that friend is leading). 'who' is the name taped on the text box; leave it out for signs and narration.

lines.text: Hold still.
Patched. All of them. I'm working on a fix for everything else.

callum.text: Your spreadsheet is not my responsibility.

nolan.text: Nolan. You came back before anyone fainted. Statistically, that's you.

haydon.text: Haydon. Before you say it: it is not cap. They're healed.

dani.text: Dani. You're here. On time. I've logged it.

lines.text: You fainted. I carried you back. Again.
Your Patchlings are patched. I'm working on a fix.
I've filled four pages of the bestiary and we've seen two Patchlings. Don't ask how.
Go find me something rare. I'll be here. Collecting.
I'll hold down the sanctuary. Someone has to be the responsible one.
PATCH keeps asking me to sign things. I'm not signing things.
Trapped inside our own video game? Nah that's cap.
...Okay. It's a little bit not cap.
I'm coming, I'm coming. Five minutes.
Bro I replied. Check the group chat.
The Hollowfolk call me the Keeper. You can call me Bron.
Somebody hit "sim to end of season" on a MyLeague save. I woke up here. That was years ago.
Nah that's cap. That's not LeBron.
Ratings froze in 2K22, young fella. Still a 97. Don't touch the stones.

callum.text: ...You. Scottish kid. Curly hair. I know that face from the loading screen.
You're the one who hit "sim to end of season".
In my defence, the playoffs were taking ages.
He's been in here YEARS, Callum.
Don't touch the stones. That one's not a request.

lines.text: That robot fell out of the sky at 3 AM. I watched the whole thing.
With a coffee.
Parker Colt. You've probably seen the page.
New post every day at golden hour. The lighting in this world is insane. Follow me.
Your name is Noah.
Noah is a private account.

callum.text: Callum. You never followed back. Since 2020.
I followed. I just had notifications off. For six years.
...Golden hour's at six. Like the post.

dani.text: Bro! I follow you. I like every post.
You liked one post. In 2021. Three months after I put it up.
